title: Sunil Kumar vs Omaxe Buildhome Pvt Ltd on 12 March, 2021
doc:
The complainant booked a flat and paid the booking amount, but possession was delayed by 42 months.

Held: The opposite party is directed to pay Rs. 12,50,000 as compensation along with interest @ 9% per annum, and Rs. 25,000 as litigation cost.
